see.liveStatus: Indoor centre closed for repairs; outdoor viewing area accessible.

eat.reason: Guardbridge Inn is lunch/dinner-led and does not meet the café, coffee-and-cake audit focus.

trails.reason: The council green-network report documents a shortage of local recreational routes and no round route.

parking.reason: The imported 137 mostly campus/residential OSM parking geometries are not verified public visitor parking; small centre parking lacks current official capacity and access details.

toilets.reason: No council public toilet is listed and the centre building is closed.

accessibility.note: Outdoor access remains; no claim is made for the closed indoor centre.

exclusions: Eden Campus parking and amenities are not treated as general tourist services.
Guardbridge Inn excluded from café-led Eat.
St Andrews and Leuchars services are not borrowed.
boundaryRule: The reserve viewpoint stays in See, but does not carry Guardbridge to 60.
